title: S&P 500 seasonal patterns — discovered on 2003-01-01..2022-12-31 ONLY
status: FROZEN — do not modify after out-of-sample data (2023-01-01 onward) is seen

data.source: Yahoo Finance chart API v8, interval=1d, period1=2003-01-01, period2=2022-12-31 (request itself bounded)
data.prices: Unadjusted index levels (price index; dividends excluded)

study.data_source: Yahoo Finance chart API v8, interval=1d, period1=2003-01-01, period2=2022-12-31 (request itself bounded)

seasonality.entry_price: close of the last trading day before the anchor date
seasonality.exit_price: close of the Nth trading day starting at the anchor date

methodology.returns: Simple price return, entry close -> exit close. Excludes dividends, transaction costs, slippage and taxes.
methodology.excess_return: Window return minus the mean return of ALL overlapping windows of the same length in 2003-2022 (unconditional drift).
tests: binomial sign test of win rate vs unconditional same-length win rate
Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across the 120 windows (and separately the 12 months)
calendar-scramble permutation (within-year common shift), max-|t| family-wise p
methodology.drawdown: Max peak-to-trough decline of daily closes inside the holding window, peak includes the entry close.

oos_test_protocol.evaluate: ALL 120 windows and 12 months exactly as defined here, not only the candidates, so the out-of-sample test cannot be cherry-picked.
oos_test_protocol.notes: Apply the same entry/exit rules and the same in-sample baseline means (do not re-estimate baselines from OOS data when computing excess return).
